decisions.choice: Native CMS signup still uses operator-allowed domains. A custom AuthAdapter can implement public getAllowedDomain for general SUBSCRIBER signup without domain rows or internals. Use exported requestSignup/completeSignup/sendMagicLink/verifyMagicLink through that adapter. SignupConfig cannot configure native CMS URLs; record that coupling without calling the helpers internal. Native tokens remain opaque CMS credentials, not service JWTs. Keep DinkusKit-owned account IDs, site-control-before-grant, and a narrow proof-labeled JWT bridge. Do not ship homemade signup/session as a product auth platform or add a public login route. Native browser/provider integration remains unproven; recommend Better Auth as the next maintained provider proof.

Recommend Better Auth behind that boundary instead of a homemade auth platform.
